text.autoconfig.palantir.title: Palantir Client
Turn all shard detection, HUD rendering and notifications on or off.

Allow your own username to raise a notification if you have added yourself to the tracked list.
You always appear in the HUD regardless of this setting.

Raise notifications for tracked players who are already in the shard the moment you connect.
Off by default, so joining a server does not produce a burst of alerts.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.hud.enab: Show the shard panel while you are in game.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.hud.anch:
Which part of the screen the panel is attached to.
Offsets are measured inwards from that edge.
Tip: bind "Edit HUD Position" under Controls to drag, and independently resize width and height, directly in-game instead.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.hud.scal: Width of the panel relative to the current GUI scale, independent of vertical scale.
Height of the panel relative to the current GUI scale, independent of horizontal scale.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.hud.show: List every detected player below the summary lines.
Move tracked players to the top of the list, keeping tab-list order within each group.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.hud.maxV:
0 shows every detected player, growing the panel to fit -- there is no minimum or maximum height.
Any other value truncates the list with a "+N more" line once it's exceeded.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.hud.hide: Hide HUD when no players are detected
Hide the panel entirely while the shard is empty.
Hide HUD when debug screen is open
Keep the panel out of the way while F3 is showing.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.notifica: Show a corner notification when a tracked player enters the shard.
Which corner notifications appear in, and the direction the stack grows.
Total lifetime of a notification, including its fade in and fade out.
Play a short vanilla note-block bell when a tracked player is detected.
Older notifications are dropped once this many are on screen.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.trackedP:
Tick this and press Save to open a dedicated screen for adding and removing tracked usernames.
Raises a notification when a tracked player enters the shard. Matching ignores capitalisation.
The setting clears itself immediately and is never stored.

Tick this and press Save to open a dedicated screen for adding and removing tracked factions.
Any member of a matching faction is treated as tracked, the same as an individually tracked username.
Use * as a wildcard, e.g. "Ikea*". Matching ignores capitalisation.
The setting clears itself immediately and is never stored.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.ignoredP:
Tick this and press Save to open a dedicated screen for adding and removing ignore patterns.
Matching players are hidden entirely: excluded from the HUD, the player count, and notifications, even if also tracked.
Use * as a wildcard, e.g. "hoodcartel*" matches "hoodcartel18" and "hoodcartelanything". Matching ignores capitalisation.
The setting clears itself immediately and is never stored.

Tick this and press Save to open a dedicated screen for adding and removing ignored factions.
Any member of a matching faction is hidden entirely, the same as an individually ignored username, even if also tracked.
Use * as a wildcard, e.g. "Ikea*". Matching ignores capitalisation.
The setting clears itself immediately and is never stored.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.appearan:
Tick this and press Save to open an interactive color wheel for all nine colors below.
The setting clears itself immediately and is never stored.
Trim the corner pixels of panels and notifications for a softer outline.
text.autoconfig.palantir.option.advanced:
Tick this and press Save to preview a sample notification with your current settings.
The setting clears itself immediately and is never stored.

How long a tracked player must stay in the shard before a notification is raised.
Leave at 0 for immediate alerts; raise it if the server briefly flickers team assignments.
Log shard membership changes to the client log. Off by default.

When debug logging is on, also log the scoreboard team each player is assigned to.
Useful for confirming that the server actually assigns teams.
